component.name: kind-miner
component.summary: Mine Monero with the CPU capacity available that you aren't using

description.p: kind-miner mines Monero with the part of your CPU nothing else is using, and steps aside the moment you need it. There is no account, no pool operator and no fee: it mines on P2Pool, which pays straight into your own wallet.

Every two seconds it measures how busy the computer is, not counting itself, and gives the miner only what is left under the ceiling you choose. Until you step away from the keyboard it mines gently, and it pauses on battery, for heat and for games. With the default node, mining traffic goes over Tor, so the node never sees your IP address.

ul.li: Four kindness presets, from Ghost to Full, changeable from the tray
A chart that shows the miner stepping aside for your work
Pauses on battery, for heat and for games
Ships XMRig, P2Pool and Tor, so nothing is downloaded on first run
